findings.summary: Benchmark numbers (13.4%, about half the allocations) were measured against 3fce3b5 rather than the PR's actual base b5611fc, so earlier commits like c5e744c and b5611fc inflate the claimed gains.

Measurements don't follow the bench README method: single percentages, no per-run numbers, affinity, LTO config, or named benchmarks, and the 3.3% control regression is unexplained against 1-4% walk gains.

why: Both findings concern how the PR body reports performance measurements; the code was judged correct, and a busy maintainer would merge without them (they did), so neither is blocking. The reviewer still said the description blocks it, so the verdict is changes.
